Brief Description
Describes the Signals of the Interaction Layer.
Description
Describes the Signals of the Interaction Layer covering the COM Signals. The Interaction Layer
packs one or more signals into assigned COM I-Pdus and passes them to the underlying layer for
transfer between nodes in a network.
